title: Season 2: Frostrealm Coming Soon
summary: We're excited to announce Season 2: Frostrealm for Infinite Realms is coming soon! The current release window is April 9th to April 15th. We'll confirm the release date next week. Season 2 will bring fresh content including a new biome, a new boss, a new element for gesture magic, new cosmetics, and bugfixes. More on this soon! Till then, here's exactly what happens when a new season begins in IR: Character Level and Skill Tree (and Accrued Skill Points) will reset.
